entries.title: Kholat

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the original full Unreal Engine 4 release with PC capture/settings flexibility. Later PS4, Xbox One, and Switch releases add access routes but no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Kholat on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check first for any display or compatibility notes before capture.
